text: Sofia, thank you for being patient — here's everything in one place. On checkout, the only three things I can require are: run the dishwasher, take out all refuse, and return any moved furniture to its original position. Stripping the bed linen is no longer something I'm allowed to ask for or charge for under the updated policy, so that task is gone entirely — and yes, that's the same task that led to the charge in July, so you won't see anything like that again. On the carbon monoxide alarm and whether there's covered bicycle storage, I need to check both and will come back to you shortly rather than guess. The same goes for a possible one-day arrival shift — it may affect the booking details and I want to give you an accurate answer, so I'll confirm that separately too.
